name: PVE LXC Apps Updater
description: Batch-updates LXC apps installed by community-scripts or Proxmox Custom Scripts. Resolves each container's update script from /usr/bin/update, with optional vzdump backups.

notes.text: Run on the Proxmox host, not inside a container. Detects LXCs tagged community-script or proxmox-helper-scripts.
Dry-run (`var_dry_run=yes`) only reports versions for check_for_gh_release apps (pangolin-site, agentgateway); Docker/uvx apps are skipped.
Downloads ct/<service>.sh from each container's /usr/bin/update repo, so custom and community-scripts apps update in one pass.
Unattended: `var_backup=no var_container=all_running var_unattended=yes var_skip_confirm=yes` with the same script.
Optional vzdump backup before each update; on failure the script can restore it. Logs: /usr/local/community-scripts/update_apps/; per-container: `pct exec <CTID> -- update`.
